OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The hunt platform the connector executes against.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_TYPE.description: Type of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.description: Maximum number of hunt runs OpenCTI may dispatch to this connector at the same time. The platform budget is the minimum of its own setting and this value.

CONNECTOR_OBSERVABLE_TYPES.description: Observable types the connector may create from hunt results, intersected with the types expected by each hunt. Defaults to IOC types only; supported values: IPv4-Addr, IPv6-Addr, Domain-Name, Url, StixFile, Email-Addr, Hostname, User-Account, Mac-Addr.

CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVABLES.description: Maximum number of observables created per hunt run (the most frequent first).

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_URL.description: URL of the OpenSearch cluster, e.g. 'https://opensearch.example.com:9200'.

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_USERNAME.description: OpenSearch user name (basic authentication). Leave empty for a cluster without the security plugin.

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_VERIFY_SSL.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the cluster.

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_CA_CERT.description: Path to a CA certificate bundle verifying the cluster certificate.

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_INDICES.description: Index patterns holding the OCSF events the hunts search.

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_QUERY_LANGUAGE.description: Language Sigma rules are translated into: 'ppl' (Piped Processing Language) or 'opensearch-lucene' (Lucene query string).

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_SIGMA_PIPELINE.description: pySigma pipeline(s) translating Sigma rules, chained with '+': 'ocsf' or 'none'.

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_TIMESTAMP_FIELD.description: Field holding the event time, used to restrict the queries to the run window.

OPENSEARCH_OCSF_HUNT_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.description: Type of the timestamp field: 'epoch_millis' (a number of milliseconds, the OCSF 'time' attribute) or 'date' (a date field such as 'time_dt').
